title: Cross field Poincare-Hopf mismatch on crawfish IMG_4118
user-messages: yes  start agent on infeasible injectivity contraints
description: Crawfish scan IMG_4118 fails in the cross field: the triangle index sum does not match the vertex cones (Poincare-Hopf). CRAW-141 (no flat fill triangles) shrank the mismatch from -14 to -2 but did not remove it, so another mesh feature causes the rest. Find the faces whose index disagrees, what is special about them, and fix it the way the cross-field papers intend.
definition-of-done:
1. The faces and vertices carrying the remaining mismatch are named and their mesh feature shown (numbers and an engine screenshot under tmp/).
2. A fix following the paper; IMG_4118 passes the cross field, and its furthest stage is reported before and after.
3. A unit test reproduces it on a hand-made fixture, failing on master and passing after.
4. The 11 suite models and the T-Rex skull are unchanged, and ixd wt perf shows no regression.
testing-plan:
1. Reproduce on the named crawfish scans on current master, saving the failure and the stage times under tmp/.
2. A unit test with a hand-made fixture that reproduces the failure without loading a scan, failing on master and passing after.
3. After the fix: the named scans, the 11 suite models (same quad, patch and cone counts), the T-Rex skull, and ixd wt perf.
